body:
# 2.4.0-koensayr-3.0.7

Koensayr is a mod for the Y1's OS that makes the following improvements to the original OS:

Browsing the albums of an artist from Main Menu > Artists > Albums

Adds Bluetooth remote control support and track info displayed on your bluetooth receiver, perfect for using your Y1 in a car with the infotainment system.


---

## Build metadata

Patched **rom.zip** built from stock **3.0.7** by [koensayr-auto](https://github.com/ryan-specter/koensayr-auto) v2.4.0.

## Upstream

- Repository: [`y1-community/y1-stock-rom`](https://github.com/y1-community/y1-stock-rom)
- Release tag: `Latest-3.0.7`
- Asset: `rom.zip`
- Upstream SHA256: `7cbffcbe7dc1beb823e9ab8d37cea6120d16856bba49e02ed2d6e1548832e695`

## Koensayr build

- Version: `2.4.0`
- Git revision: `16f65333696597b084d34931d4c94f7c5352e9e5` (includes `com.innioasis.y1` APK patches under `src/patches/`)

## Build output

- Patched `rom.zip` SHA256: `b5b8cfbb651460e989a2cfb93a4f9b5e610a76015103e69bac382ba65f9bf97a` (see `build-manifest.json` on this release)
- Upstream `rom.zip` was re-hashed at build time; output must differ (CI enforces this).

## Patches (`--all`)

- Music-player UX (Artist→Album navigation)
- Bluetooth pairing (`audio.conf` / `auto_pairing.conf` / `blacklist.conf` / `build.prop`)
- System config (ADB debugging, bloatware removal)
- Root (`/system/xbin/su`, mode 06755)
- AVRCP 1.3 metadata + control + Y1Bridge

Diagnostic scripts (`tools/dual-capture.sh`, gdb attach, `btlog-dump`) are **not** included in the ROM — see the repo [Diagnostics](https://github.com/ryan-specter/koensayr-auto#diagnostics).

## After flash

If AVRCP / MultiDex classes fail to load after upgrading from a prior koensayr build:

```bash
adb shell rm -rf /data/data/com.innioasis.y1/code_cache/secondary-dexes/
```
